exposure: Head and neck cancer (HNC) during pregnancy or early postpartum
outcome: Disease status (evidence of disease/no evidence of disease)
cohort: The study included 15 women diagnosed with head and neck cancer either during pregnancy or within 12 months after delivery.
finding: All patients received state-of-the-art therapy with encouraging long-term results, highlighting treatment safety in women with HNC during pregnancy.
gest_age: Median gestational age at cancer diagnosis was 28 weeks (range: 16-40 weeks) in cases diagnosed during pregnancy.
